= Xref role passthroughs
:role-name: hot
:role-markup: +hot+

Plain: xref:target[role=hot].

Macro: xref:target[role=pass:[hot]].

Double: xref:target[role=++hot++].

Triple: xref:target[role=+++hot+++].

Quoted: xref:target[role="+hot+ cool"].

Multiple: xref:target[role="pass:[hot] pass:[cool]"].

Earlier passthrough: pass:[before] xref:target[role=pass:[hot]].

Protected plus signs: xref:target[role=pass:[+hot+]].

Protected attribute: xref:target[role="+{role-name}+"].

Attribute: xref:target[role={role-name}].

Attribute markup: xref:target[role={role-markup}].

Escaped: xref:target[role=\+hot+].

Quoted escape: xref:target[role="\+hot+"].

Special characters: xref:target[role=pass:[hot&cold]].

Explicit label: xref:target[Named,role=pass:[hot]].

Formatted: *xref:target[role=pass:[hot]]*.

External: xref:other.adoc#target[Other,role=pass:[hot]].

[[target]]
== Target
